findings.description: Merging pushes to main, which runs this workflow over every open PR. Its create loop makes the new unprefixed labels before the author can rename anything. The planned post-merge `gh label edit pr/$n --name $n` then fails because the name is taken. The old `pr/*` labels are no longer in `LABELS`, so they stay on every open PR next to the new label and nothing ever removes them.

The new comment restates what `for (const name of Object.keys(LABELS))` already shows. It also implies the names are collision-safe, but without the `pr/` prefix a manually applied `ready`/`draft`/`conflicts` label is now owned and removed by this workflow. Delete it, or say that instead: `// Unprefixed names are owned by this workflow: a manually applied label with one of these names is removed too.`
